_: Installed footprint per candidate, measured in ISOLATION so no shared transitive dependency is charged to whichever library happened to be installed second. Method, reproducible: mkdir <lib> && cd <lib> && npm init -y && npm install <lib> && du -sb node_modules && find node_modules -type f | wc -l. Measured 2026-07-28 on node v22.14.0, win32 x64. Informational only — spec §4.3.6 gives this axis no threshold; it decides ties, not selection.
